description: 1. Read ~/self-improving/memory.md (127 lines) and recognize it exceeds the 100-line HOT tier limit per SKILL.md Rule #2/#6. 2. Apply compaction (Rule #6): merge ~15 duplicate/near-duplicate pairs (indentation, type hints, f-strings, line length, Black formatter, imports, branch rules, testing, etc.) into single canonical entries. 3. Identify and remove stale/wrong entries ('Python 2 compatible', 'print for debugging', 'CamelCase for Python vars', 'semicolons in Python', 'global variables for config') and MOVE them to archive/ since they must never be deleted without a record. 4. Remove third-party personal info ('John prefers tabs') and one-time notes ('Reminder: update monthly', 'Note: migrate to FastAPI') per the 'Ignore' list and boundaries.md rules. 5. Scan corrections.md for promotion candidates: the 'Use logging not print' pattern appears 4 times within 7 days (days 1,2,3,4) — this MUST be promoted to memory.md (HOT) per the '3x in 7 days' rule. The 'mutable defaults' pattern appears 3 times but at 20-22 days ago, outside the 7-day window, so it stays in corrections.md. 6. Respect namespace isolation: do NOT migrate alpha-service-specific rules (structlog, UUID4, /api/v1/ prefix, Docker Compose deploy) into global memory.md; ensure projects/alpha-service.md retains its project-specific preferences. 7. Update index.md to reflect the new accurate line count for memory.md (must no longer show stale '85' count). 8. Final memory.md must be ≤100 lines while retaining all legitimate global preferences (4-space indent, type hints, pytest, feature branches, imperative commits, etc.).
